title: IS 14543:2016 — Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
content: Indian Standard for packaged drinking water other than natural mineral water. According to BIS, the standard specifies limits for physical parameters (such as TDS and turbidity), microbiological parameters (such as E. coli, yeast and mould), chemical parameters (such as pH), and pesticide and radioactive residue levels. Packaged drinking water is under compulsory BIS certification under the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulation, 2011. BIS titles the standard "Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification". A 2024 revision of IS 14543 may exist; this record cites the 2016 edition described on the BIS blog.
document_name: BIS Blog: Compulsory BIS Certification of Packaged Drinking Water and Packaged Natural Mineral Water

title: IS 13428:2005 — Packaged Natural Mineral Water
content: Indian Standard for packaged natural mineral water. According to BIS, packaged natural mineral water is under compulsory BIS certification under the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulation, 2011, and may not be manufactured or sold except under the BIS Certification Mark. BIS titles the standard "Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification".
document_name: BIS Blog: Compulsory BIS Certification of Packaged Drinking Water and Packaged Natural Mineral Water

title: IS 17526:2021 — Domestic Stainless Steel Vacuum Flask / Bottle
content: Indian Standard applicable to domestic stainless steel vacuum (insulated) flasks and bottles used to carry hot or cold beverages and drinking water. BIS operates product certification (ISI Mark, Scheme I) for this product under IS 17526:2021; the BIS Product Manual PM/17526/3 covers licensing under the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018, and BIS lists insulated flasks, bottles and containers for domestic use as being under compulsory certification (mandatory ISI Mark). The BIS Product Manual notes the inner container must be stainless steel grade 304 or higher. The full standard title and technical scope were not verified from the BIS standards catalogue.
document_name: BIS Product Manual PM/17526/3 (December 2024) — Domestic Stainless Steel Vacuum Flask / Bottle
reference: Product Manual for IS 17526:2021 (Scheme I certification)

title: IS 17803:2022 — Potable Water Bottles (Copper, Stainless Steel, Aluminium)
content: Indian Standard applicable to non-insulated potable water bottles made of copper, stainless steel or aluminium and designed for carrying drinking water. According to BIS, the standard excludes insulated flasks and vacuum flasks (those are covered by IS 17526). BIS states that compulsory certification has been mandated for several products related to portable and drinking-water containers, and a manufacturer needs a BIS licence to use the Standard Mark. The full standard title and technical scope were not verified from the BIS standards catalogue.
